correctness.rationale: The proof fixes conventions and quantifiers, gives the principal-open upper bound, and proves the matching lower bound by showing that any categorical open containing two global maxima would make an embedded two-top capped base null-homotopic. An explicit retraction converts that into contractibility of the slice, contradicted by an independent Stong-core argument. The argument works coordinatewise for every finite number of factors. Finite computation is explicitly supplementary rather than an infinite proof.
